annotations.text:
Rebuilt from the Kyo 2.0 screenshots
Home follows the Kyo 2.0 dashboard: a peach blueprint-grid background, a contextual line, a huge wide date (14.09 LUN) with an orange 'Tutto pronto?', then 'In arrivo' task cards (exam; deadline with a checkbox) and 'Orario di oggi' as filled colour cards, each group inside a soft translucent ring. Courses and news lists follow; the 'Adesso' pill floats above the glass tab bar.
The course page sits on a background tinted in the subject's colour, with a centred glyph and title. The next sitting is a glossy card with a serif number, like Kyo's Report Card. Rows split icon | label with the value in orange. A glass circle and a big tinted glass action button sit at the bottom.
The exam opens as a warm cream sheet with centred icon, title and description (like Kyo's Schedule and Edit Mapping sheets), a from/to range for the enrolment window, and a primary glass button.
All values are sample data.
